title: Parallax-web
blurb: An open-world game experiment and web-platform research vehicle running client-side with WebGPU, WASM threads, SharedArrayBuffer workers, and Chrome's built-in AI Prompt API.
imageAlt: Near-photorealistic 4K view of a seaside village with a castle on a nearby hill, farmland, forests, and distant mountains. High fantasy open-world action RPG setting.
